data.one_liner: Select local pictures and videos, preview media, and save to albums
data.what_it_does: Supports local picture and video multi-selection, capturing photos or videos via camera, previewing media files, and saving network or local images and videos to device albums.
use_when: You need multi-selection for both local images and videos.
You need to save network images/videos or screenshots directly to the gallery.
avoid_when: You need a cross-platform solution with robust web support (this is Android/iOS only).
You are using older Android target SDK versions without upgrading to targetSdkVersion 34.
strengths: Supports multi-selection of both images and videos
Built-in media preview and saving functions for network media and screenshots
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms
Requires specific Android target/compile SDK configurations for Android 13+
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS Info.plist permissions (NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, NSCameraUsageDescription, etc.) and Android targetSdkVersion/compileSdkVersion 34.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official and more widely used package for picking images and videos from the gallery or taking them with the camera.
